enabled.description: Whether the a2jmidid daemon should be enabled (start on boot).

realtime.description: Enable real-time scheduling for lower MIDI latency (requires CAP_SYS_RESOURCE or running as root).

priority.description: Real-time priority level (1–99); higher values = higher priority. Only used if `realtime=true`.

max_ports.description: Maximum number of MIDI ports per client (0 = unlimited). Prevents runaway port creation.

port_idle_timeout.description: Time in milliseconds to wait before automatically closing unused ALSA→JACK or JACK→ALSA ports.

jack_buffer_size.description: JACK period size (frames/period). Leave blank to inherit from JACK server.

jack_sample_rate.description: JACK sample rate (Hz). Leave blank to inherit from JACK server.

ports.description: Specific ALSA MIDI ports (client:port) to expose. Leave empty to expose all ports.

items.description: ALSA MIDI port identifier in the form `client:port`, e.g., `20:0` for FluidSynth.

exclude_ports.description: ALSA MIDI ports (client:port) to exclude from bridging.

items.description: ALSA MIDI port identifier in the form `client:port`, e.g., `20:0`.

timing_source.description: Source of timing and transport info: `alsa` (ALSA sequencer) or `jack` (JACK transport).

transport_sync.description: Whether to synchronize JACK transport (play/stop/position) with ALSA MIDI transport messages (if supported by client).

transport_mode.description: Transport role when `transport_sync=true`: `none`, `slave` (follow JACK), or `master` (control JACK).

startup_timeout.description: Time in milliseconds to wait for JACK to start; if exceeded, daemon exits (0 = wait forever).

log_file.description: Path to write logs. Leave blank to log to stderr instead.
